claim_boundary: Exact finite symplectic transpose/inversion computation. A unique nonsymmetric pair does not by itself decide whether the full Hecke algebra is commutative.
theorem: The rank-31 relative-position geometry of W33 slices in W(11,3) has exactly one non-self-inverse double-coset pair; the other 29 double cosets are self-inverse. The unique pair has signatures (0,2,0,4,4,0) and (0,2,2,4,2,0), and both actual orbitals have valency 8,459,973,849,600.
transpose_formula: For A:X->U with P=A J A^T, the reversed projection is C=-J A^T J; K_A reverses to ker(C), while K_B=X cap U maps to rowspace(K_B A).
